title: Polyglot Search Engine
description: Distributed search engine with async web crawling, inverted indexing, ranked retrieval with sub-50ms cached responses, and click-through analytics. Built as polyglot microservices (Python FastAPI + Node.js NestJS) with Kafka event streaming, Redis caching, PostgreSQL storage, and Nginx gateway.

title: Basira
description: Private, offline document reader for people with low vision. Photograph a paper, bill, or medicine leaflet — Basira reads it aloud and explains it in simple words using local OCR, LLM, and TTS models. Supports Arabic and English with zero cloud dependency.

title: Magitsh
description: Full Git version control implementation in Node.js with core commands (init, add, commit, branch, checkout, merge, diff, log). Implemented Git internals (blobs, trees, commits) with SHA-1 hashing, zlib compression, and DAG-based commit history with BFS for merge-base detection and three-way conflict resolution.

title: Speakify
description: Scalable backend architecture for an online English learning platform in the Arab world. Integrated Paymob payments with webhooks, i18next localization, geo detection, and CDN media delivery.

title: Rochetta
description: Full-stack healthcare & pharmacy management platform for browsing, managing prescriptions, inventory tracking, and purchasing medicines online.

title: Bash-Elbalad
description: Custom Linux shell engine in C++ implementing process management, command parsing, piping, redirection, and environment variable resolution.

title: Business Incubator Platform DBMS
description: Database-driven web and desktop application designed to manage business incubator operations, startup pipelines, and mentor matching efficiently.

title: Neural Network From Scratch
description: Feedforward neural network implementation from first mathematical principles in C++, featuring matrix operations, forward/backpropagation, and gradient descent optimization.

title: Quran Audio Player & Playlist Manager
description: Cross-platform audio player built in C++ using irrKlang sound engine with custom 2D doubly linked list navigation algorithms for efficient reciter and surah traversal.

title: Monte Carlo Pi Estimation
description: Interactive visual probabilistic simulation estimating the value of Pi using random sampling and geometric probability via the Monte Carlo method in JavaScript.

title: HR Tracker
description: Desktop management application built for the HR leadership team at ICPC Zagazig Community to track, score, and analyze competitive programming community cohorts.

title: Amazon Products Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Exploratory data analysis on Amazon product datasets investigating pricing distributions, discount elasticities, customer rating correlations, and business performance metrics.

title: Learnova
description: Full-stack e-learning and course distribution management platform designed to streamline student enrollments, instructor dashboards, and multimedia content delivery.

title: 2048 Puzzle Game
description: Clean browser implementation of the classic 2048 puzzle game with tile animation algorithms, score caching, and keyboard event bindings.

title: EchoSteps
description: 2D arcade platformer game built in Java using Swing graphics engine, featuring custom physics collision detection, sprite animation, and state controllers.

title: Pokemon 2D Battle Game
description: Retro 2D Pokemon-inspired browser mini-game featuring turn-based battle mechanics, HP calculations, and canvas rendering.

title: Contact Manager Book
description: C++ contact management application built with object-oriented principles, dynamic memory allocation arrays, persistent file stream I/O, and binary search.
